en_title: Final Fantasy 7 Director Kept 'Open World Fatigue' in Mind as New Remake Chapter Promises 'Bigger' World Than Rebirth
cn_title: 《最终幻想7：启示》世界更大但不会让玩家迷路
subtitle: 开放世界也需要恰到好处的引导

paragraphs.en: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation director Naoki Hamaguchi has acknowledged the "open world fatigue" affecting the industry but says Square Enix was "very careful" to make sure fans would have "all the guidance they need" in the new remake chapter – even if it's bigger than the last.
paragraphs.cn: 《最终幻想7：启示》导演滨口直树承认，「开放世界疲劳」正在影响整个行业。不过他表示，即使重制系列新篇章的世界比上一作更大，史克威尔艾尼克斯也「非常谨慎」地确保粉丝获得「所需的一切引导」。

paragraphs.en: The two previous installments in the remake trilogy – Final Fantasy 7 Remake and Rebirth – have been lumped into online conversations about enormous open worlds that sometimes overstay their welcome. Hamaguchi said the concept of open world fatigue is "very important" to him, but it sounds like players won't need to worry about feeling too lost.
paragraphs.cn: 重制三部曲的前两作《最终幻想7 重制版》和《最终幻想7 重生》，都曾被卷入有关超大型开放世界容易令人生厌的网络讨论。滨口称，开放世界疲劳这个概念对他而言「非常重要」，但玩家似乎不必担心在新作中彻底迷失方向。

paragraphs.en: There are certainly players who would prefer to get lost in a vibrant fantasy universe. In a world promising to be as packed as Final Fantasy 7 Revelation, that idea might be especially enticing. Hamaguchi said that, as a creator, he believes it's important to "offer proper guidance" in open-world games so that players "know what to do, and know where to go."
paragraphs.cn: 当然，也有玩家更愿意迷失在生机勃勃的幻想世界里。对于内容看起来会像《最终幻想7：启示》一样充实的世界，这种体验或许尤其诱人。滨口表示，作为创作者，他认为开放世界游戏必须「提供适当引导」，让玩家「知道该做什么，也知道该去哪里」。

paragraphs.en: "In Final Fantasy VII Rebirth, we made sure to make it easy for the players to understand how much content there is, and how difficult that content is," he added. "That design philosophy is applied to Revelation: players have all the guidance that they need. This is something that both myself and the development team were very careful about when we designed the game."
paragraphs.cn: 他补充道：「在《最终幻想7：重生》中，我们确保玩家能够轻松了解游戏有多少内容，以及这些内容的难度。《启示》也延续了这种设计理念：玩家会得到所需的一切引导。这是我和开发团队设计游戏时都非常谨慎对待的一点。」

paragraphs.en: It seems Hamaguchi and the rest of the development team wanted to strike a balance when it came to guidance in Final Fantasy 7 Revelation. One example he mentioned involved asking players to rely on their memory to make sure they land in their desired location when dropping from the Highwind airship .
paragraphs.cn: 看起来，滨口和开发团队希望在《最终幻想7：启示》的引导设计上取得平衡。他举例说，玩家从飞空艇「高风号」降落时，需要依靠自己的记忆，才能确保落在目标地点。

paragraphs.en: "That's another example of the guidance we're giving players, without directing them too much," Hamaguchi continued. "The world is even bigger than it was in Rebirth, so it is more important than ever for us to ensure there's enough guidance here, so people have no issues enjoying what this game has to offer."
paragraphs.cn: 滨口继续说道：「这也是我们在不作过度指示的前提下为玩家提供引导的例子。游戏世界甚至比《重生》更大，所以我们比以往任何时候都更需要确保引导充足，让所有人都能顺畅享受游戏提供的内容。」

paragraphs.en: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation currently has no firm release date but is expected to launch for PC, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X | S in spring 2027. While we wait for updates, you can read about what Hamaguchi had to say about the feedback to Remake and Rebirth's vast pool of mini-games . You can also learn about the leak that suggests DLC may be in development .
paragraphs.cn: 《最终幻想7：启示》目前尚无确切发售日，预计于2027年春季登陆PC、Nintendo Switch 2、PlayStation 5和XBOX Series X|S。在等待新消息期间，你可以了解滨口如何回应玩家对《重制版》和《重生》大量小游戏的反馈，以及暗示DLC可能正在开发的泄露消息。

summary: 滨口直树表示，《最终幻想7：启示》的世界将比《重生》更大，但团队充分考虑了开放世界疲劳，通过清晰又不过度的引导帮助玩家掌握内容规模、难度和前进方向。
opus_summary: 新作地图比《重生》更大，开发团队却不想让玩家被清单和路标淹没。滨口直树希望用适度引导，在探索自由与明确目标之间取得平衡。
